lines.zh: 四足着地，一步一步踏出深坑
lines.en: On all fours, each step sinks a deep print.

lines.zh: 十二米的翼折起来，走路像扛着帐篷
lines.en: Wings folded, I walk like a tent on legs.

lines.zh: 长颈前探，我在草丛里扫视
lines.en: Neck thrust forward, I sweep the brush with my eyes.

lines.zh: 每落一次脚，地面都震一下
lines.en: The ground thuds with every footfall.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，个头不允许我快
lines.en: I walk slowly; my size forbids speed.

lines.zh: 翼尖拖在地上，划出两道痕
lines.en: Wingtips drag the earth, leaving two furrows.

lines.zh: 脖子高过树冠，我边走边看远处
lines.en: Neck above the treetops, I watch the distance as I go.

lines.zh: 趾骨撑住体重，走得稳当却沉重
lines.en: My toes bear the weight, steady but heavy.

lines.zh: 我从林间穿过，树都往两边躲
lines.en: I pass through the woods, and the trees give way.

lines.zh: 喙离地两米，走的每一步都长
lines.en: My beak rides two meters up; every stride is long.

lines.zh: 我转向时得走个弧，转不直
lines.en: To turn I need an arc; I cannot pivot sharply.

lines.zh: 地面上我不是猎手，只是过路的巨影
lines.en: On the ground I am no hunter, just a passing giant.

lines.zh: 枯枝在我脚下碎成粉末
lines.en: Dead branches crumble to powder under me.

lines.zh: 我停下又起步，像一座挪动的塔
lines.en: I halt and start again, a moving tower.

lines.zh: 我直立着，比周围的树还高
lines.en: Standing upright, I top the nearby trees.

lines.zh: 长喙垂在胸前，我一动不动
lines.en: My long beak hangs at my chest; I do not stir.

lines.zh: 风穿过翼膜，声音像帆
lines.en: Wind crosses my membrane with a sail-like sound.

lines.zh: 我颈上的褶皱在光里泛白
lines.en: The folds on my neck pale in the light.

lines.zh: 我在等风向，也在等气味
lines.en: I wait for the wind, and for a scent on it.

lines.zh: 我的影子铺开十几米
lines.en: My shadow stretches a dozen meters.

lines.zh: 头微侧，我听见远处有骨响
lines.en: Head tilted, I hear bones crack far away.

lines.zh: 喙太大，反而不好藏
lines.en: A beak this big is hard to hide.

lines.zh: 我张开翅又收拢，只是松松筋骨
lines.en: I spread my wings and fold them, merely loosening up.

lines.zh: 这片地界是我的，气味已留下
lines.en: This ground is mine; my scent is already on it.

lines.zh: 我呼吸时，胸骨鼓得很慢
lines.en: My breastbone swells slowly with each breath.

lines.zh: 翼上的皮膜薄得透光
lines.en: The skin of my wings is thin enough to show light.

lines.zh: 远处一头小兽在跑，我没追
lines.en: A small beast runs in the distance; I do not chase.

lines.zh: 我把喙插进土里，又拔出来
lines.en: I stab my beak into the soil and pull it out.

lines.zh: 我从高处低下头看你
lines.en: I lower my head from above to look at you.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里只到我的膝盖
lines.en: You reach only my knee in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，喙尖对准你
lines.en: I tilt my head, beak tip aimed at you.

lines.zh: 这么大的喙，一口能含住你
lines.en: A beak this size could hold you whole.

lines.zh: 我打量你的骨头，不是你的脸
lines.en: I appraise your bones, not your face.

lines.zh: 你站得很稳，这点让我感兴趣
lines.en: You stand firm; that interests me.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，影子把你盖住
lines.en: One step, and my shadow covers you.

lines.zh: 风把你的气味吹进我喉咙
lines.en: The wind carries your scent down my throat.

lines.zh: 我不急，我从不急
lines.en: I am in no hurry; I never am.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西太小，我看不清
lines.en: What you hold is too small for me to see.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚过一声闷响
lines.en: A low rumble rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 我低下喙，几乎碰到你的头
lines.en: I dip my beak until it nearly touches your head.

lines.zh: 我闷叫一声，脖子缩了半截
lines.en: I grunt once and pull my neck back.

lines.zh: 这点伤不算什么，但我记住了
lines.en: This wound is nothing, but I remember it.

lines.zh: 我踉跄半步，翼擦过地面
lines.en: I stumble half a pace, wings scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 血沿着喙边往下淌
lines.en: Blood runs down the edge of my beak.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，把痛甩开
lines.en: I shake my head to throw the pain off.

lines.zh: 羽膜震了一下，风都乱了
lines.en: My membrane shudders and the airflow breaks.

lines.zh: 我转过身，正面朝你站稳
lines.en: I turn to face you and plant my feet.

lines.zh: 这么大的身体，疼起来也大
lines.en: A body this large hurts in proportion.

lines.zh: 我低吼着，把步子往后退
lines.en: With a low growl, I back away.

lines.zh: 你以为大了就好打？
lines.en: You think size makes me easy prey?

lines.zh: 这么大一块肉，值得我弯下脖子
lines.en: A piece of meat that size is worth bending my neck.

lines.zh: 我低下长喙，慢慢靠近
lines.en: I lower my long beak and approach slowly.

lines.zh: 肉味太重了，我挪不动脚
lines.en: The smell of meat is so heavy I cannot move on.

lines.zh: 我试着咬，可喙太宽
lines.en: I try to bite, but my beak is too broad.

lines.zh: 你给我，我就收下
lines.en: Offer it, and I will take it.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸得很长，像一条蛇
lines.en: I stretch my neck long, like a snake.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻你的手，才咬肉
lines.en: I sniff your hand before taking the meat.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，你最好松手
lines.en: When I bite, you had better let go.

lines.zh: 我被这块肉牵着走，真丢脸
lines.en: This meat leads me around; how undignified.

lines.zh: 我低头，喙尖轻轻夹住
lines.en: Head down, my beak tips gently clamp it.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞一根柱子
lines.en: You hit my leg as if against a pillar.

lines.zh: 我被撞得偏了半步，很重
lines.en: I shift half a step from the blow, heavily.

lines.zh: 我的喙扫过你，把你推开了
lines.en: My beak sweeps past and pushes you aside.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，你退了三步
lines.en: We collide; you retreat three paces.

lines.zh: 我脚下的地震了一下
lines.en: The ground shakes under my feet.

lines.zh: 这么大的身体，撞上就躲不掉
lines.en: A body this size cannot dodge a collision.

lines.zh: 我低头看是什么撞了我
lines.en: I look down to see what struck me.

lines.zh: 翼骨撞得发出闷响
lines.en: My wing bones answer with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 你比我灵活，但你比我小
lines.en: You are quicker, but far smaller.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，给你让出通路
lines.en: I turn my flank to let you pass.

lines.zh: 我张开十二米的翼，向你示意
lines.en: I spread twelve meters of wing to signal you.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，颈子交叠
lines.en: We stand side by side, necks crossing.

lines.zh: 巢要建在开阔的高地，够大
lines.en: The nest must be on open high ground, and large.

lines.zh: 我用喙推来枯枝，堆成台
lines.en: I push dry branches with my beak into a platform.

lines.zh: 我低下头，让你的头靠过来
lines.en: I lower my head so yours can lean in.

lines.zh: 叫声低得能传过整片林
lines.en: Our low calls carry across the whole forest.

lines.zh: 我们轮流守着这片地
lines.en: We take turns guarding this ground.

lines.zh: 翼膜相触时，风都停了一瞬
lines.en: When our membranes touch, the wind pauses.

lines.zh: 我看你的眼神比看猎物温和
lines.en: I look at you more gently than at prey.

lines.zh: 这么大的巢，只有我们一起才守得住
lines.en: A nest this size only the two of us can guard.

lines.zh: 我夹起那块肉，仰头吞了
lines.en: I clamp the meat and swallow it head-high.

lines.zh: 喙太宽，东西老从缝里漏
lines.en: My beak is too broad; things slip through the gap.

lines.zh: 我用喙把骨头挑起来
lines.en: I flick the bone up with my beak.

lines.zh: 太重了，我得分两口叼
lines.en: Too heavy, so I carry it in two bites.

lines.zh: 我把它压在爪下，慢慢撕
lines.en: I pin it under my foot and tear it slowly.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，我都怕咬碎
lines.en: So small I fear I will crush it.

lines.zh: 我叼着它抬头，像举着旗
lines.en: I lift it in my beak like a banner.

lines.zh: 我闻了一遍，才决定咽下
lines.en: I sniff it all over before deciding to swallow.

lines.zh: 我把它扔到巢里，留给以后
lines.en: I toss it into the nest for later.

lines.zh: 喙一合，连骨头都响
lines.en: One snap, and even the bone cracks.

lines.zh: 那头幼兽离群了，我盯住它
lines.en: That juvenile strayed from the herd; I fix on it.

lines.zh: 你进入了我的猎场范围
lines.en: You have entered the range of my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我一低头，脖子绷成一条线
lines.en: Head drops, my neck pulls into a line.

lines.zh: 猎物不大，但也够一顿
lines.en: Small prey, but enough for a meal.

lines.zh: 我先看退路，再看你
lines.en: I check the escape routes, then you.

lines.zh: 风从你那边吹来，位置清楚了
lines.en: The wind comes from your side; your position is clear.

lines.zh: 我张开翼，投下的影子就是信号
lines.en: I spread my wings; my shadow is the signal.

lines.zh: 它跑起来了，我记住了方向
lines.en: It runs; I memorize the direction.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，就不再改主意
lines.en: Once locked, I do not change my mind.

lines.zh: 这种体型，跑不过我
lines.en: Nothing that size outruns me.

lines.zh: 喙尖微张，我在估你的厚度
lines.en: Beak slightly open, I gauge your thickness.

lines.zh: 远处的骚动引我转头，就是它
lines.en: Movement far off turns my head; that is the one.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫会惊走它
lines.en: I stay silent; a cry would scare it off.

lines.zh: 十二米的翼，投下的阴影已经够吓人
lines.en: A twelve-meter wingspan casts a shadow scary enough.

lines.zh: 我一步步跟着，地面在响
lines.en: I follow step by step, the ground answering.

lines.zh: 你跑向树线，我直接跨过去
lines.en: You run for the treeline; I simply stride over it.

lines.zh: 我抬高脖子，从上面看着你
lines.en: I raise my neck and watch you from above.

lines.zh: 我不追快的，我等它累
lines.en: I do not chase the swift; I wait for fatigue.

lines.zh: 翼半张，我随时能起跳
lines.en: Wings half spread, I could launch at any moment.

lines.zh: 你换了方向，我跟着转
lines.en: You change direction; I turn with you.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很沉，但脚步不乱
lines.en: My breath is heavy, but my steps stay steady.

lines.zh: 喙对着你，像一根长矛
lines.en: My beak points at you like a lance.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面，堵住你的路
lines.en: I swing to your flank and cut off the path.

lines.zh: 你在喘，我还没开始
lines.en: You are panting; I have not even begun.

lines.zh: 每靠近一步，影子就压得更低
lines.en: With each step my shadow presses lower.

lines.zh: 这片开阔地，藏不住东西
lines.en: This open ground hides nothing.

lines.zh: 我停下来，只为了看清你往哪跑
lines.en: I pause only to see which way you bolt.

lines.zh: 那头幼兽的母亲不在附近
lines.en: That juvenile's mother is not nearby.

lines.zh: 我耐性好得可怕，你不知道
lines.en: My patience is terrifying; you do not know it yet.

lines.zh: 长喙像长矛一样扎下
lines.en: My long beak stabs down like a lance.

lines.zh: 我一口夹住，甩起脖子
lines.en: I clamp down and whip my neck up.

lines.zh: 翼扫过来，风先到
lines.en: My wing sweeps in, the wind arriving first.

lines.zh: 脚掌踩下，地面陷了
lines.en: My foot comes down and the ground dents.

lines.zh: 我低头一啄，骨头都响
lines.en: One peck and bones crack.

lines.zh: 这一击够吞下一头幼龙
lines.en: This strike could swallow a young tyrannosaur.

lines.zh: 我从上方压下，你无处可躲
lines.en: I press down from above; there is nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 喙尖穿透，再往上一挑
lines.en: My beak punches through, then flicks upward.

lines.zh: 我用整个身体的力量撞过去
lines.en: I drive my whole body into the blow.

lines.zh: 你被掀翻，我退开半步看你
lines.en: You are flipped; I step back half a pace to watch.

lines.zh: 这不是撕咬，是把猎物整块提起
lines.en: Not a bite, but lifting the prey whole.

lines.zh: 喉咙深处发出满足的闷响
lines.en: A satisfied rumble rolls from deep in my throat.

lines.zh: 第二次落下时，你已经慢了
lines.en: On the second strike you are already slow.

lines.zh: 天空的巨影，落到地上就是锤
lines.en: A giant of the sky becomes a hammer on the ground.

lines.zh: 翼影扫过林梢，我落了下来
lines.en: My wing shadow sweeps the canopy; I come down.

lines.zh: 一声低鸣从高空传到地面
lines.en: A low call travels from high sky to ground.

lines.zh: 十二米的翼展开，树枝全断
lines.en: Twelve meters of wing unfold, snapping branches.

lines.zh: 我从云下出现，像一座移动的山
lines.en: I emerge beneath the clouds, a walking hill.

lines.zh: 这片林子太小，装不下我
lines.en: This forest is too small to hold me.

lines.zh: 落地时扬起的土盖住了草
lines.en: Dust from my landing buries the grass.

lines.zh: 我收起翼，站直，比树还高
lines.en: I fold my wings, stand tall, taller than the trees.

lines.zh: 空气里忽然有一股骨的腥味
lines.en: A raw bone smell suddenly fills the air.

lines.zh: 我踩着倒下的树走过来
lines.en: I walk over fallen trunks to get here.

lines.zh: 风声变了，是被我的翼挡开的
lines.en: The wind changes; my wings are what blocks it.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，鸟群全飞散
lines.en: I call once, and the birds scatter.

lines.zh: 长颈从树冠间探出来，是我
lines.en: A long neck rises over the canopy; it is mine.

lines.zh: 脚掌落下，远处的动物都停了
lines.en: My foot lands, and distant animals freeze.

lines.zh: 我从海的另一边飞来，翼还湿着
lines.en: I flew from beyond the sea, wings still wet.

lines.zh: 最高处那块岩石归我了
lines.en: The highest rock is mine now.

lines.zh: 地上多了一片不属于树的阴影
lines.en: A shadow appears that belongs to no tree.

lines.zh: 喙尖在日光里亮成一条白线
lines.en: My beak tip glints as a white line.

lines.zh: 我到了，这里就安静了
lines.en: I have arrived; the place falls silent.

lines.zh: 火贴上翼膜，烧出一片焦黑
lines.en: Fire touches my membrane and scorches a black patch.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来，腿都发麻
lines.en: I crash down from height, legs numb.

lines.zh: 水从我喙缝灌进去，我猛抬头
lines.en: Water pours through my beak gap; I jerk my head up.

lines.zh: 气浪推得我转了个身
lines.en: The blast spins me around.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我胸骨，很浅，但烦
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my breastbone, shallow but annoying.

lines.zh: 某种东西从里往外烧，我看不见
lines.en: Something burns from inside out, and I cannot see it.

lines.zh: 我饿得连草都啃了两口
lines.en: Hunger is so bad I even chew grass.

lines.zh: 雷劈在翼骨上，我全身一麻
lines.en: Lightning hits my wing bones; numbness floods me.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，只有往下掉的空
lines.en: No ground under me, only falling emptiness.
